note: A targeted follow-up on Airwallex only, recorded separately from the 23 October 2026 research. It does not change edition 001’s observations, statuses, findings or the observations CSV.
method: Each page was fetched by a server and rendered in a browser (Chrome, not signed in, Canadian locale) on 30 October 2026 between 1:40 p.m. and 1:41 p.m. Toronto time. The captures are kept privately outside the repository; their SHA-256 hashes are recorded here.

findings.text: Pricing lists up to 1% cash rebates on local CAD spend, marked with a footnote that terms and conditions apply; the footnote links to the cash rebate promotion terms.
findings.quote: Up to 1% cash rebates on local CAD spend

findings.text: The linked terms (last updated 3 January 2025) describe a new-customer promotion for Canadian customers: up to 1% on eligible CAD and USD transactions in a calendar month with at least CAD 2,000 of card spend, where an eligible CAD transaction is CAD 25 or more with a merchant in Canada. The promotion period is 1 June 2024 to 31 December 2025, unless Airwallex notifies otherwise.
findings.quote: ends on 31 December 2025, 23:59 PST (both dates inclusive), unless otherwise notified by Airwallex

findings.text: The card page describes spending from the account balance and states 1% cashback on every eligible transaction with no cap.
findings.quote: Every eligible transaction earns 1% cashback, with no cap.

findings.text: Pricing lists a credit line for corporate cards and does not explain its eligibility or repayment terms.
Explore includes up to 10 free Spend users; Grow is $12 per active Spend user a month (up to 250 Spend users) plus a platform fee based on team size; Accelerate has custom pricing.
findings.quote: $12 per active Spend user/month up to 250 Spend users

not_established: Whether the promotion was extended beyond 31 December 2025: none of the three pages states an extension.
Whether new customers can currently receive the rebate.
The credit line’s eligibility, limits or repayment terms.
proposed_research_changes: Airwallex rewards (O-AWX-04, reconciliation class B and D): the terms answer the class D question about the rebate terms; they show conditions (new customers, CAD 2,000 a month, CAD 25 Canadian-merchant transactions, a 2025 end date) that the card page’s “1% cashback, with no cap” does not state. A reviewer may reclassify this as a difference between published statements in a future edition. Not changed here.
Finding 1 (2 of 5 platforms that published a reward rate) is not affected: Airwallex still published a reward rate on 30 October 2026, and it is not one of the two platforms counted.
